free_tier.stated: Deliberately tiny, by policy. CRAN policy: 'As a general rule, neither data nor documentation should exceed 5MB ... Source package tarballs should if possible not exceed 10MB.' Larger tarballs need a individually-granted exception ('a modestly increased limit can be requested at submission').

retention.stated: per-object-cap: 10 MB source tarball (soft, 5 MB for data/doc). retention: indefinite per version, old versions archived

egress.terms: Free and globally mirrored (hundreds of CRAN mirrors). No metering.

record.tooling: `R CMD build` + `devtools::submit_cran`, `rhub`; mirrored tarballs at /src/contrib/. No rclone backend.
record.chaining: unlimited packages x unlimited versions x 10 MB. CRAN is explicitly hostile to bulk data: 'A CRAN package is not an appropriate way to distribute course notes'. Human review on every submission.

limits.value: review make this unusable for bulk

record.limits_note: per-object-cap: 10 MB source tarball (soft, 5 MB for data/doc). retention: indefinite per version, old versions archived. request-rate: submission is manual/email-reviewed.
record.reliability_note: 10 MB per version and human review make this unusable for bulk; recorded so nobody re-checks it.
